name: Hex
tagline: Hex is a collaborative data workspace where analysts and data scientists work on notebooks, dashboards, and data apps in a shared environment. Teams use it for exploratory analysis and building internal tools that non-technical stakeholders can interact with. Its AI features help write SQL, debug code, and generate chart configurations from natural language prompts.
